subject: Account renewal: request for premium SLA after August performance degradation
content:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@neptunepay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@neptunepay.com>, legal@neptunepay.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Service availability impact — renewal conversation

Hi Stephanie,

We had two production windows last week where response latency spiked and a small percentage of requests returned 5xx. Our platform ingested payments during both windows and that caused downstream retries and operational toil for our on-call team.

We appreciate Redwood's response during the incidents, but given the impact on our payment flows we want to revisit the renewal terms. Specifically, we're asking for: 
- A path to an elevated SLA (99.95% availability + tighter P95 latency target) for our renewal
- A guaranteed routing to premium capacity during business hours (M–F 6am–8pm PT)
- A refundable credit for the August incident window while we work on a long-term plan

Attached are the incident logs and a short timeline (neptune_incident_logs_aug.zip). Can you confirm next steps and whether Redwood can provide a term sheet for the premium tier ahead of our procurement window (we need an internal decision by Aug 25)?

Thanks,
Sarah Klein
Head of Platform
Neptune Payments

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@neptunepay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service availability impact — renewal conversation

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and for the logs. I’m really sorry for the disruption last week; we take availability concerns seriously.

Immediate next steps I can commit to: 
1) Schedule a post-incident sync with our engineering and SRE leads (Markus Klein will join) to review the timelines and root causes — proposed: Thu 13 Aug, 10:00am PT.
2) Share a draft term sheet for the premium SLA (99.95% + latency SLOs) by end of day Fri 14 Aug so you can start procurement review.
3) Provide a credit calculation for the Aug window after the post-incident review.

We can also put in place a temporary routing policy to ensure higher-priority requests are served on dedicated premium capacity during your business hours while we finalize contract language. I’ll loop Rishi and Grace to align on commercial and operational details.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@neptunepay.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service availability impact — renewal conversation

Sarah — appreciate the clear ask. Commercially we can move Neptune to the Enterprise Premium tier with a 12-month committed plan that includes: 
- SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime, P95 generation latency under 350ms for the configured route
- Business-hours premium routing and capacity reservation (M–F 6am–8pm PT)
- Credit policy aligned to incidents (we'll provide the exact calculation after the RCA)

I'll draft a term sheet with pricing and include an option for a 3-month pilot on Dedicated capacity if you'd like a low-friction way to validate stability. 

Two asks from our side: 
- Can Neptune confirm the routes/endpoints and expected QPS during business hours?
- Will procurement need a separate vendor security addendum?

I’ll attach a preliminary term sheet tomorrow.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales — Americas
Redwood Inference

---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@neptunepay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service availability impact — renewal conversation

Hi all — Markus and I reviewed initial telemetry and the attached incident artifacts. Quick summary: 
- Root cause appears to be correlated with a combination of a sudden traffic spike and an LRU cache eviction issue on the model KV store during a deployment window.
- Error rate peaked for ~18 minutes on Aug 7 at ~03:12 UTC; we saw a small increase in 5xx across one shard.
- We can implement a short-term mitigation (sticky routing + aggressive KV cache retention) that should reduce error surface and reduce latency spikes within 24 hours.

Markus will bring the technical plan to the RCA call. We’ll prepare a write-up and include suggested config changes to be applied to your routes if you approve.

Attachments: redwood_incident_summary_aug7.pdf

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@neptunepay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@neptunepay.com>
Cc: legal@neptunepay.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service availability impact — renewal conversation

Appreciate the quick triage. Procurement/legal here — we will need the formal term sheet and sample SLA language to route to our vendor review board. Also need confirmation of the credit calculation methodology and whether the premium routing incurs any additional onboarding fees.

Can you include a proposed amendment that we can attach to the current order form? Also please flag any data residency or audit log changes required for premium routing.

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Neptune Payments

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@neptunepay.com>, Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@neptunepay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, legal@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service availability impact — renewal conversation

Tom/Sarah — thanks for the clarity. Per our commitments: 
- Rishi attached the draft term sheet and pricing in HubSpot (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/NP-2026-RW-0192).
- Markus and Grace will deliver the RCA and a technical amendment (redwood_premium_sla_term_sheet_v1.pdf) by EOD Mon 17 Aug that includes the credit calc methodology and any data/audit implications.
- We will provision a temporary premium routing policy tonight to cover business hours through your decision date (Aug 25).

Next steps: 
1) Confirm a 30-minute RCA + commercial sync on Mon 17 Aug at 9:00am PT.
2) Neptune to share QPS by route and any specific compliance constraints for the premium routing.

If that plan works, I’ll mark the deal as "priority" and request expedited legal review internally so we can get you a clean amendment quickly.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced in thread:
- neptune_incident_logs_aug.zip (attachment from Neptune)
- redwood_incident_summary_aug7.pdf (attachment from Redwood)
- redwood_premium_sla_term_sheet_v1.pdf (to be delivered)
